title: Chapter 320 Yamamoto County
content:
Chapter 320 Yamamoto County

Three days later, Zhong Yu's injuries eased a little, at least when he was walking and moving around, he would not feel unbearable pain all over his body.

That's right, when he came to this world a few days ago, Zhong Yu's injuries were so serious.

Every step he takes, every movement of his body, is the greatest damage to his body. The ubiquitous pain in his body had penetrated deep into his bone marrow and soul, tormenting him.

But it's much better now.

After the recuperation of true qi transformed by the obtained trace of luck, although the body still has a faint pain, it is far less severe than it was at the beginning.

And through these three days of cultivation, not only did he feel much better physically, but he also learned a lot about the news of this world through the mouth of this woman, Kazuko, and gradually gained an outline.

This is also one of the reasons why Zhong Yu agreed to shelter and Meizi.

Kazuko can have such an outstanding appearance, and her manners are quite elegant, and she knows some etiquette movements.

This is not something that ordinary villagers can have, and even the wives and daughters of ordinary lords and warriors cannot have such etiquette.

Obviously, this woman, Kazumiko, came from an extraordinary background.

Zhong Yu quickly discovered this point through brief contact, and asked directly, but the answer he got made him even more lament the helplessness of the troubled times.

It turns out that the reason why Kazuko married her husband, the lord of the village, was not voluntary, but forced.

This goes back many years. Kamiko was born into a daimyo family and was the second daughter of that daimyo.

Kazuko has received excellent etiquette training since she was a child, which is necessary for her to be married to other families in the future.

However, when Kazumiko reached the age of marriage, she was finally going to marry another daimyo heir with the same noble status.

But on the way to see her off, she was brutally robbed by bandits. In the melee, Kazumi panicked and separated from the team.

Then, she met her husband who had just died.

The samurai became interested when he saw the beauty, and seeing He Meizi's outstanding looks, he couldn't help being distracted, and had a different idea.

Then through questioning and probing, after learning that she is the daughter of a daimyo, her inner lust became even more daring.

Directly disregarding Kazuko's resistance, he forcibly raped her, then took her to his current hometown, forced her to marry her as his wife, and came to this small village to conceal the news.

After coming and going, thirteen years have passed in a blink of an eye, and Kazumiko has changed from a 14-year-old girl to a 27-year-old young woman now, and she gave birth to a son and a daughter to the samurai.

After such a long time, especially after the present children, Kazumiko also accepted her fate, and lived a solid life with that samurai.

How could he have imagined that after finally getting settled down, he would suddenly encounter such a disaster.

Her husband died, and the whole family had no one to rely on, and Kazuko had to give up her dignity, and came to ask Zhong Yu for protection.

Therefore, Kazumiko, who has all kinds of experiences, is extremely extraordinary in her own birth, and she has a basic understanding of the external situation through some information that her husband usually says.

Through Hemiko's mouth, Zhong Yu understood the general shape of the world.

As expected, this world is really similar to the background of the Sengoku period in Japan.

And on top of the historical background of the Warring States Period, I listened to many gods, demons and monsters that originally only existed in mythology.

Especially similar to the monsters that were beheaded by Zhong Yu at the entrance of the village before, this kind of low-strength ghosts can be found in every village and every region in Japan.

And the whole world is divided into 66 countries, which are ruled by the daimyo of each country, and there is even a powerful national football that occupies a country.

It can be said that today's Japan is divided into hundreds of forces, large and small. They are intertwined and entangled with each other, and they are allied with each other, which has created this chaotic world today.

However, because of the large number of these forces, the strength of each force is not very strong.

Occupying one or two villages in today's Japan and drawing out its own name is called a power.

Occupying a township, there are a dozen or so villages under his control, the annual grain output of the territory is more than 10,000 shi, and there are about 300 soldiers.

This kind of strength is called daimyo, and he is already qualified to spread his fame to several surrounding countries.

He is deeply awed by everyone, and has left a strong mark in the history of Japan's Warring States Period.

Occupying the territory of a country is also the territory of a county. With thousands of troops under his command, he is already a powerful force with the ability to influence the situation of the world. Its master will be deeply remembered by the history of the Warring States Period.

And where Zhong Yu is now is located in the northeast of Japan, which is equivalent to a barbarian land in the eyes of the Japanese.

Dewa country has a large population, more than 300,000 people, but its area is two to three times that of other countries. In comparison, the population of 300,000 is not very large, but rather sparse.

Today, this small mountain village is located in the northernmost part of Dewa country, backed by the coastal Yamamoto County.

Dewa country has 12 counties, among which Yamamoto County is not ranked, it is far away from the center, and belongs to the poor and desolate county.

But even so, Yamamoto County also has a population of 20,000.

Now Yamamoto County is ruled by a Yamamoto family ruler, but the territory is not completely unified, and there are still three or four forces that do not obey the rule of the Yamamoto family.

More or less, these forces have a military strength of one hundred or hundreds of people.

As for the Yamamoto family, all mobilized, they were able to summon an army of thousands of people. And there are hundreds of warriors among them, ranking first among all the families in the county.

And this small village belongs to the Dongping family, a family with more than 200 armed forces.

The Dongping family owns five villages with a population of about a thousand people, including 20 warriors. Their strength cannot be underestimated.

Zhong Yu was lying on the bed, thinking about the message He Meizi had given him, and gradually had a plan.

Today, the forces in the entire Yamamoto County are mixed, and they are fighting endlessly. For the hegemony of the entire Yamamoto County, you come and go, and you are beaten to death, and no one will give in.

This also created Yamamoto County, which is not strong at all, and its power has become more dispersed.

After the power is dispersed, Zhong Yu will have the possibility to defeat each of them.

Now Zhong Yu's strength has partially recovered, and with its powerful soul energy, it can definitely run rampant throughout the Dongping family.

Before, Zhong Yu relied on the energy of his soul to blow away the monster whose strength was as high as the peak of the first order with a single stare.

But that time was a coincidence, because he had just come to this world, and the power of the body and space had not completely dissipated, so it had a miraculous effect.

Now that it has been so long, the power on his body has long faded, and the power of space has disappeared in a blink of an eye.

It is impossible to want to be like before.

But even so.

Now that Zhong Yu's strength has also returned to the second level, he still has a little bit of self-protection ability.
